MOD = 1000000007
LIMIT = 2000
SIZE = 2005

dp = [[0] * SIZE for _ in range(SIZE)]
ok = [[0] * SIZE for _ in range(SIZE)]
ok[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, LIMIT + 1):
    start = i % 2
    for j in range(start, i + 1, 2):
        if j == 0:
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][1]
            if ok[i - 1][1] == 1:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + 1) % MOD
            else:
                ok[i][j] = 1
        else:
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j + 1]) % MOD
            if ok[i - 1][j + 1] == 1 or ok[i - 1][j - 1] == 1:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + 1) % MOD
            else:
                ok[i][j] = 1

n = int(input())
print(dp[2 * n][0], end='')
